definitionOfDone: Verify both declared prerequisites are DONE/merged from epicSiblings and preserve the three adopted daemon WIP paths byte-for-byte before red-first additions; record exact-path porcelain/blob hashes and never recover from the pre-WIP ref.

A focused <=250-line affordance-planning-authorities.ts calls the existing daemon journeyAuthority producer (no copied codec/digest) and returns an immutable planningAuthorityByRun map only for exact eligible plan.propose/approval.decide offer runs. Each entry has exactly authority, goalRef, graphContentBytesBase64, graphContentHash, graphRevisionRef, runId, and submissionHash; two nondefault goal/run pairs produce distinct correctly bound material.

AffordanceSurface exposes planningAuthorityByRun alongside planningGoalRefs, and createAffordancePort derives both from the same durable offers/bindings. With a configured principal and exactly one merged node, the authority-map key set equals the nonzero eligible offered-run set in both directions; each map key, embedded runId, goalRef, offer target, criterion/revision identity, and configured author agree exactly.

Production daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts forwards the real StoreDependencyConfig.principalId and existing mergedNodes into createAffordancePort. Missing principal, zero or multiple nodes, missing run-to-goal binding, or mismatched/withheld offer yields no authority entry; no DEFAULT_*, project owner, first-node selection, caller-provided identity, static digest, or operator-local fallback is admitted.

Existing compiler/bootstrap/claim/offer behavior and public step shapes remain compatible; only the new top-level authority map and optional port principal input are added. Both new production files remain <=250 lines, every edited production file remains <400 physical lines, and the .js bridge is exactly one re-export line.

Red-first focused tests assert the exact seven-key roster, nonzero bidirectional run coverage, configured-principal versus deliberately different project-owner provenance, two-sibling isolation, and every fail-closed omission. Restored mutations substituting a default run/goal, swapping one sibling goal, and dropping one map member make the named production-surface assertions red; reason/outcome assertions identify the exact refusing layer where a real command is driven.

Run the exact standalone focused daemon gate with nonzero Test Files/Tests counts, @moe/daemon typecheck and package tests, then the repository root lanes and path-attributed merge-base-versus-HEAD comparison; no new failure may intersect the seven owned paths and all foreign red is disclosed verbatim.

implementationPlan.description: PHASE 0 — ADOPT THE HUMAN-AUTHORIZED DAEMON WIP AND RE-MEASURE BEFORE EDITING. Read parent comment-9ab9b346375b46f9a17dde85e46bcb9c and the parent handoff, verify task-4451675e309e4db5b7388ecabc05b44f and task-4942111bdaac427985e4636b2bbd0cad are DONE/merged from epicSiblings, and confirm parent task-0169055cad324b7f84a2e90f0b46f8e0 is the named consumer whose dependency-field update is pending with the governor. Record HEAD and exact-path porcelain/blob/SHA-256 for the three adopted dirty WIP paths; compare their semantic bytes with the parent step notes, never with the pre-WIP recovery ref, and stop rather than restore/normalize if they differ. Call moe.declare_files for exactly the seven task paths and record that the two new files do not yet exist, the other four non-WIP paths are clean, and all foreign dirt is untouched. Re-run shape/reachability scans for createAffordancePort, AffordanceSurface object literals, planningGoalRefs, exact surface key rosters/counts, journeyAuthority importers, node/principal sources, and .js bridge conventions; stop for re-plan if a new asserting consumer needs an eighth path. Capture fresh pre-leaf standalone baselines for the focused daemon tests, @moe/daemon typecheck/package test and the required root lanes, including nonzero Test Files/Tests lines and every foreign failure path.

RED-FIRST PRODUCTION-SURFACE TESTS. In affordance-read-planning.test.ts build a real surface with configured principalId `configured-operator`, a deliberately different registered project owner, exactly one nondefault node, and two nondefault durable goal/run siblings. From the production readSurface result require a nonzero eligible-run denominator; bidirectional set equality between exact plan.propose/approval.decide offer targets and planningAuthorityByRun keys; distinct per-run entries with exactly the seven keys authority, goalRef, graphContentBytesBase64, graphContentHash, graphRevisionRef, runId, submissionHash; exact key/run/goal/criterion/revision/node/configured-author agreement; and no default/sibling literals in B. Add divergent zero-node, two-node, omitted-principal, missing-binding and mismatched/withheld-offer arms that keep the relevant offers/bindings otherwise valid and assert exact map omission, never merely failure. In affordance-read.test.ts pin the new top-level map without weakening the existing bidirectional served/carded roster or completed WIP assertions. Use the existing real planning handler only for one positive material-consumption arm and one swapped-sibling arm: keep both offers/bindings valid, substitute only B's production-surface material onto A's proposal terminal, and assert the exact ILLEGAL_TRANSITION / CORE_REDUCER refusal so no later persistence fence can answer first. Run only these two test files, prove nonzero collection, and record the expected red assertions before production edits.

IMPLEMENT THE FOCUSED CANONICAL MATERIAL PRODUCER AND CONTRACT. Create affordance-planning-authorities.ts (<=250 physical lines) with immutable PlanningAuthorityMaterial/PlanningAuthorityByRun behavior over explicit server inputs: current offers, planningGoalRefs, optional configured principal, and one already-snapshotted node roster. Consider only plan.propose/approval.decide run targets; require a nonempty own run→goal binding, a nonempty configured principal, and exactly one valid node; de-duplicate exact runs without choosing a first conflicting fact. Call the existing journeyAuthority exactly once per eligible run with configured author, `${goalRef}-criterion`, `${runId}-graph-revision`, run idPrefix, the sole nodeRef and the established planning step description; carry its returned authority/bytes/hash/submission digest verbatim and add only explicit runId/goalRef/graphRevisionRef. Do not copy a codec, digest, canonicalizer, graph literal, DEFAULT_* value or project owner. Freeze each exact seven-key entry and the map. Add the repository-standard one-line .js re-export bridge. In affordance-contract.ts add the exact material types and the top-level planningAuthorityByRun field without changing ChainStep, NextAllowedCommand, refusal, or existing planningGoalRefs shapes.

COMPOSE THE REAL DAEMON SURFACE WITHOUT FALLBACKS. In affordance-read.ts add only an optional principalId input (absence must yield an empty material map), snapshot config.nodes() once per read, derive planningAuthorityByRun from the same resolvePlanningOffers result/planningGoalRefs that produced the cards, return it on every SURFACE, and reuse that exact node snapshot for later node cards so the read cannot mix two rosters. Preserve the already-completed removal of default planning cards, exact offer-derived step identities, compiler/claim/session/review behavior, mint/clock semantics, refusal shapes and public exports; do not edit affordance-planning-offers.ts. In daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts forward config.principalId and the existing mergedNodes provider—never ledger project owner or a literal—into createAffordancePort. Make the red tests green, including `{}` for missing/ambiguous facts and the real sibling material drive, then run daemon typecheck. Review physical lines: both new files <=250 and every edited production file <400 without minification; split/report before crossing 400. No docs change is needed because this is an internal authenticated surface field with the parent consumer already named.

PENULTIMATE ADVERSARIAL REVIEW AND RESTORED MUTATION DRILLS. Run the adversarial-self-review checklist over own-property bindings, duplicate/empty offer targets, zero/multiple/mutating node rosters, absent/empty principal, producer exceptions, sibling isolation, nested mutability, exact key rosters, and accidental DEFAULT_/owner/first-node fallbacks; verify HTTP/MCP generic serializers need no edit and the parent is still the declared consumer. Before every mutation capture `git status --porcelain` for the exact mutated paths. Because both new files are untracked, back them up to a worker-suffixed out-of-tree `$env:TEMP` directory and record SHA-256. Drill independently: (A) substitute DEFAULT_RUN_SUBJECT or a literal author in the canonical input and require the exact per-run/configured-author surface assertion to red while offers/bindings stay valid; (B) replace B's goal lookup with A/first-entry and require the exact B criterion/contract assertion to red; (C) drop one material map member and require the nonzero bidirectional set-equality assertion to red; (D) swap only sibling material on the real proposal and require ILLEGAL_TRANSITION @ CORE_REDUCER. A green mutant is a finding, not evidence. Restore in separate commands, then separately prove SHA-256 equality for untracked files and `git diff --exit-code` for tracked files.

FINAL CONCENTRATED VERIFICATION AND COMPLETION EVIDENCE. From repo root run this exact foreground/unpiped completion command and persist it verbatim in moe.complete_task.verification.command: `& {$p='pnpm.exe';&$p --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/http/affordance-read.test.ts src/http/affordance-read-planning.test.ts;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE};&$p --filter @moe/daemon typecheck;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE};&$p --filter @moe/daemon test;exit $LASTEXITCODE}`. Read output, not only exit 0: require focused Test Files 2 passed with nonzero Tests, successful daemon typecheck, and full daemon nonzero Test Files/Tests. Then run `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (root lane only; apps/** not covered), `pnpm verify:foundation`, and `pnpm verify:store` separately/standalone; compare their failing-path sets and the daemon package set with the phase-0 pre-leaf baseline, require no new failure intersecting the seven owned paths, and disclose foreign red verbatim. Re-run exact shape/reachability grep and line counts, prove the diff/pathspec is a subset of the seven declared paths, both new-file hash restores and tracked-file restores hold, and the parent consumer dependency field names this DONE leaf before completion (if the pending governor update is still absent, report blocked rather than completing a producer without its edge). CompletionSummary records nonzero map/offer counts, exact seven-key roster, configured-principal/unique-node evidence, sibling real-handler outcome/code/layer, drill results, line counts, WIP adoption provenance, and exact test counts.
